primary_endpoint: Change in ALT from baseline to end of treatment (8 weeks).
efficacy_outcome: Reported ALT-change values were 136.44 vs 117.40 and 112.78 vs 89.40 for losartan vs placebo; no statistical comparison was provided.
safety_signal: Serious adverse events: 0/9 with losartan and 0/5 with placebo; no deaths.
